summary: Private equity involves investment partnerships that buy and manage companies before selling them, typically using outside investor capital and debt. The industry has grown rapidly but faces challenges like a decline in assets under management, a backlog of unsold deals, and criticism over its impact on health care and other sectors. Various investment options exist, from traditional funds to publicly traded PE firms and ETFs.
entities: Invesco Global Listed Private Equity ETF

claims.text: In 2024, buyout investment value rebounded by 37% year over year to $602 billion.
claims.evidence_quote: In 2024, buyout investment value rebounded by 37% year over year to $602 billion, reflecting the industry’s resilience.

claims.text: Total announced global private equity deal volume increased 22% from $1.3 trillion in 2023 to $1.7 trillion in 2024.
claims.evidence_quote: The total announced global private equity deal volume increased 22% from $1.3 trillion in 2023 to $1.7 trillion in 2024

claims.text: Private equity assets under management fell by about 2% to $4.7 trillion in 2024, the first decline since tracking began in 2005.
claims.evidence_quote: Private equity assets under management fell by about 2% to $4.7 trillion in 2024—the first decline since tracking began in 2005

claims.text: Global buyout distributions fell to an annualized 11% of net asset value based on data through the third quarter of 2024, the lowest level in more than a decade.
claims.evidence_quote: Global buyout distributions fell to an annualized 11% of net asset value based on data through the third quarter of 2024, the lowest level in more than a decade.

claims.text: The average holding period for private equity investments has lengthened to five or more years from about 4.2 years earlier in the 2020s.
claims.evidence_quote: recent data shows holding periods have lengthened significantly, with sponsors having the average holding period lengthening to five or more years from about 4.2 years earlier in the 2020s.

claims.text: Global buyout funds raised 23% less in 2024 than in 2023, and the decline continued by an additional 11% in 2025.
claims.evidence_quote: global buyout funds raising 23% less in 2024 than in 2023. The decline continued by an additional 11% in 2025.

claims.text: A 2025 bipartisan Senate Budget Committee report found that private equity ownership of hospitals had 'detrimental effects' on patient care in underserved communities.
claims.evidence_quote: a 2025 bipartisan Senate Budget Committee report, led by Senators Sheldon Whitehouse and Chuck Grassley, found that private equity ownership of hospitals had “detrimental effects” on patient care in underserved communities.

claims.text: Leonard Green & Partners received $424 million in distributions and more than $13 million in fees from Prospect Medical Holdings.
claims.evidence_quote: Leonard Green & Partners (LGP), which reported approximately $85 billion in assets under management as of Dec. 31, 2025, received $424 million in distributions and more than $13 million in fees from Prospect Medical Holdings.

claims.text: One academic study estimated that private equity ownership increased short-term mortality among Medicare nursing home patients by 11% relative to non-private-equity ownership.
claims.evidence_quote: one academic study estimated that private equity ownership increased short-term mortality among Medicare nursing home patients by 11% relative to non-private-equity ownership.

claims.text: A 2019 cross-industry study of 484 public-to-private leveraged buyouts found an approximately 20% bankruptcy rate, compared with 2% among matched control companies.
claims.evidence_quote: a 2019 cross-industry study of 484 public-to-private leveraged buyouts found an approximately 20% bankruptcy rate, compared with 2% among matched control companies.

claims.text: In 2024, private-equity-backed companies accounted for 56% of U.S. corporate bankruptcy filings involving at least $500 million in liabilities and 11% of the qualifying corporate bankruptcies counted.
claims.evidence_quote: In the tracker’s 2024 dataset, private-equity-backed companies accounted for 56% of U.S. corporate bankruptcy filings involving at least $500 million in liabilities and 11% of the qualifying corporate bankruptcies counted.

claims.text: Private equity assets are projected to more than double from $512.0 billion in 2025 to $1,237.4 billion by 2034.
claims.evidence_quote: private equity assets are projected to more than double from from $512.0 billion in 2025 to $1,237.4 billion by 2034

claims.text: The SEC adopted final rules in August 2023 that included quarterly statements detailing fund performance, fees, and expenses, but the Fifth Circuit vacated those rules on June 5, 2024.
claims.evidence_quote: The SEC adopted final rules in August 2023 that included quarterly statements detailing fund performance, fees, and expenses, as well as annual fund audits. However, the Fifth Circuit vacated those rules on June 5, 2024

claims.text: Private equity firms traditionally charge '2 and 20' fees: 2% annual management fees plus 20% of profits.
claims.evidence_quote: complex fee structures (traditionally “2 and 20“—2% annual management fees plus 20% of profits)

claims.text: In 1901, J.P. Morgan bought Carnegie Steel Corp. for $480 million and combined it with other companies to create U.S. Steel.
claims.evidence_quote: In 1901, J.P. Morgan bought Carnegie Steel Corp. for $480 million and combined it with Federal Steel Company, National Tube, and several other companies to create U.S. Steel.
